research.title: Baseline Classification of Pavement Defects in Image Patches
bullets: Prepared labeled pavement image patches by checking annotation consistency, removing duplicate crops, and organizing training and evaluation splits by source image.
Implemented prescribed histogram of oriented gradients and support vector machine baselines, examining classification errors associated with shadows, surface texture, and ambiguous labels.

work.title: Image Ingestion and Validation Services
bullets: Maintained image ingestion routines that checked file readability, normalized metadata fields, and routed invalid uploads for review within an existing processing service.
Added regression tests for malformed files and inconsistent metadata, investigated processing failures, and documented corrective changes for routine maintenance.

projects.title: Color Histogram Baseline for Image Retrieval
bullets: Implemented a baseline image retrieval pipeline using normalized color histograms and nearest neighbor ranking over a labeled collection of object photographs.
Compared histogram distance measures and inspected retrieved examples to identify sensitivity to background color, illumination changes, and visually similar objects.

projects.title: Background Subtraction for Foreground Detection
bullets: Implemented a running average background subtraction baseline for fixed camera video, applying thresholding and connected component filtering to extract foreground regions.
Examined foreground masks against manually marked frames, documenting errors caused by cast shadows, gradual lighting changes, and objects remaining stationary.
